title: Cows With Buns
duplicate_check: No matching host in prior-urls.json, catalog-baseline.json published_games, or previously_seen_urls.
controls_actions: Opened Play, then Let’s moo-ve! to enter Level 1: Feedlot Fields.
Held Right for 1.5 seconds; Bessie moved across the level, the view scrolled, and the score rose from 0 to 10 after collecting a clover.
Held Right again; a pitchfork-carrying human enemy and a caged animal appeared ahead.
Read the game’s How to play panel: arrows/A-D move; Up/W jumps; J/X fires buns; Down/S drops through planks; P pauses; M mutes.
gameplay_outcome: Actual in-level movement and a score change were observed. HUD showed 3 hearts, 0/4 cows freed, 0/3 clovers at entry; score became 10 after movement. No claim that the animal rescue objective was completed.
mechanics: Cartoon platform action: move and jump across a farm level, collect clovers, free animals by touching or firing buns at a pen; friendly animals follow and fire buns too. The instructions state buns convert hostile workers into nonviolent, happier roles.
visual_art: Original bright flat-cartoon farm art, rounded cow protagonist carrying a bun blaster, pink barn, fences, clovers, and human enemies.
existing_custom_cover_evidence: The title screen has a bespoke COWS with BUNS graphic and illustrated farm backdrop; no separate cover asset was verified.
thumbnail_concepts: Text-free close-up of Bessie aiming a sesame bun blaster as a surprised farmhand and bright pink barn fill the background.
A small herd bursting from a pen behind Bessie, bun projectiles and clover pickups sweeping diagonally across a sunny feedlot.
screenshot_note: Gameplay screenshot was captured and shown inline in the CUA tool output; this subagent CUA surface exposes no supported local screenshot-file export, so no path was saved.
audio: The game was first entered before browser-level mute was available. Its in-game toggle was later set to Sound off, but that is not proof of browser-level muting. All test tabs were closed immediately when parent reported the user still heard audio; no further testing.
